title: entropy-bleed-quant-smoke-notes-2026-12-15
content:
Meeting: Applied ML — weekly research sync (informal)
Date: 2026-12-15
Facilitator: Maya Chen
Attendees: Maya, Arjun, Sofia, Diego (+ async notes from Priya)
Location: #applied-ml-weekly / Zoom

Goal: quick smoke pass on compact quant onboarding for small LLM variants, capture first-order diffs, decide on go/no-go for next-stage eval runs. Focus areas: entropy-bleed behaviour observed in 4-bit KVs, eval dataset sanity checks, and onboarding checklist adjustments.

Summary (TL;DR):
- Ran smoke suite across three quant profiles (int4-symmetric, int4-asymmetric, 4bit-fp8-hybrid) on two model checkpoints (v2.1-small, v2.1-medium).
- Observed a consistent "entropy bleed" pattern in int4-symmetric when prefix cache > 1024 tokens: generation collapsed to short repetitive tokens in ~3–7% of runs.
- int4-asymmetric reduced the collapse rate to ~0.8% but costlier in memory; hybrid profile looks promising (latency tradeoff).
- Small evals (SQuAD-style QA and Code-synthesis on 100-shot curated set) showed avg EM drop of 1.8 pts for hybrid, 4.9 pts for int4-symmetric.
- Decision: proceed to mid-stage evals for hybrid and int4-asymmetric; put int4-symmetric on hold pending KV-cache isolation experiments.

Notes + raw observations:
1) Smoke-run configuration:
   - Host: dedicated-dev-gpu-05 (A100s), batch=4, max_new_tokens=256, prefix_cache_enabled=true (kv-cache warm).
   - Profiles:
     * P1: int4-symmetric (per-channel scaling)
     * P2: int4-asymmetric (per-tensor zero-point + nonuniform scale)
     * P3: 4bit-hybrid (4-bit weights + 8-bit residuals on attention module)
   - Seeded runs: 500 prompts from production prompt-fuzz (small subset).

2) Entropy-bleed detail (new term we used in the meeting):
   - Symmetric int4 shows spike in low-entropy tokens after long prefixes (>1024 tokens). Hypothesis: quantized KV accumulation amplifies rounding noise that biases softmax toward a few tokens.
   - Failure mode: repetition or early stop token generation around token 12–30 of the decode window.
   - Reproducibility: reproduces locally with deterministic seeds; frequency increases with longer histories.

3) KV-cache isolation experiments (action required):
   - Diego to try per-layer clipped accumulation (clip at 2.5 sigma of observed float deltas) and re-run 1k-sample smoke.
   - Arjun to push small kernel change that zero-fills stale cache lines when switching quant profiles (PR draft: linked_artifacts[0]).

4) Eval quick stats (100-sample micro-evals):
   - SQuAD-like QA: baseline v2.1-small FP16 EM: 78.4
     * P1 int4-symmetric: 73.5 (delta -4.9)
     * P2 int4-asymmetric: 76.9 (delta -1.5)
     * P3 hybrid: 76.6 (delta -1.8)
   - Code-synthesis (unit tests): pass rate baseline 64%
     * P1: 51%
     * P2: 60%
     * P3: 59%
   - Latency (p95, ms, single token step): baseline FP16 28ms
     * P1: 21ms
     * P2: 23ms
     * P3: 26ms

5) Onboarding checklist updates (quick wins):
   - Add a mandatory "kv-history-length" field in onboarding metadata to capture typical prefix lengths in customer's workload.
   - Add smoke-case #7: "long-prefix repetition" (2500+ tokens) to autop-run.
   - Update model-card template to include quant-sensitivity note and recommended default profile.

6) Experiment artifacts and reproducibility notes:
   - Random seeds, exact config, and docker image tags are in the PR; we should snapshot run-ids to S3 and attach to JIRA AM-6421.
   - Make sure to tag runs that hit entropy-bleed with label: entropy-bleed:v1 for easier triage.

7) Open questions / risks:
   - Is entropy-bleed specific to per-channel symmetric scaling? Could be exacerbated by activation ranges shifting under certain token distributions. Need profiler traces of QKV attention mats.
   - Customer impact surface: workloads that do long-context summarization or chat history replay are vulnerable. We should classify existing Dedicated customers by typical prefix length before recommending int4-symmetric.

8) Action items (owners + due dates):
   - Diego: run clipped accumulation experiment + post results (2026-12-20).
   - Arjun: land zero-fill KV-lines kernel change PR and benchmark (2026-12-18).
   - Sofia: expand micro-eval set to 500 examples including multi-turn chat, schedule runs for hybrid+asymmetric (2026-12-22).
   - Maya (me): draft short one-pager summarizing the entropy-bleed failure mode for product and solutions (2026-12-17).

9) Notes to self / ephemeral thoughts:
   - Could be useful to add a small diagnostic probe that computes per-token KL between quantized/unquantized logits during decode — low overhead if done sparsely.
   - Consider small fallback policy in Redwood serving layer: if per-token KL exceeds threshold for N tokens, fall back to higher-precision profile for remainder of request. Tradeoffs need simulation.

Appendix (links & quick refs):
- PR: https://github.com/redwood-inference/quant-playbook/pull/178 (kernel zero-fill draft)
- JIRA AM-6421: EV: collect run snapshots + triage entropy-bleed cases
- Confluence: Quant-field-notes-2026 (working doc)

End notes: keep this doc informal — use it to capture quick decisions. Will convert to a polished postmortem if Diego finds a deterministic root cause.

-- Maya
